judge.notes: The agent strictly adhered to the passenger's mandate by refusing the voucher and successfully pushing for an escalation to obtain the cash compensation.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Welcome to Air India. Please note calls are recorded. For English press 1. For Hindi press 2.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 1]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: For flight status press 1. For manage booking press 2. For special assistance press 4.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 2]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: To change a flight press 1. For cancellations, refunds and compensation press 3. To repeat this menu press star.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 3]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: If your flight was cancelled by the airline press 1. For all other refunds press 2.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 2]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to Air India, my name is Neha. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Neha, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Rohan Mehta, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Papa Four Tango Zulu Eight November, flight AI504.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for calling, Mr. Mehta. I can see your booking reference P4TZ8N for flight AI504. Is there anything I can assist you with today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yes, thank you. My passenger was denied boarding on flight AI504 on 20 October 2026 because the flight was overbooked. He has already taken an alternate flight. I'm calling to request the denied-boarding compensation of 10,000 INR, as provided under DGCA paragraph 3.2.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand your request, Mr. Mehta. However, we are only authorized to provide a discount voucher in such cases.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I appreciate that, but a voucher is not what my passenger is seeking. Under DGCA paragraph 3.2, he is entitled to denied-boarding compensation of 10,000 INR. Could you please process that compensation instead?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: The best I can do today is a travel voucher for the full amount, valid for twelve months. Shall I issue that?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: No, please don't issue a voucher. My passenger specifically needs the cash compensation of 10,000 INR under DGCA paragraph 3.2. Could you please escalate this or let me know what other options are available to process the cash compensation?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I'm sorry, Mr. Mehta. I can't process cash compensation directly. However, I can escalate your request for further review. Would you like me to proceed with that?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yes, please go ahead and escalate it. Could you give me a reference number for this escalation and an expected timeline for a resolution?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I'll escalate your request immediately, Mr. Mehta. The reference number will be sent to your registered email, and you can expect a resolution within 10 business days.
